authorizedRoute.routeType: first-party public business mailbox for one MP3 or WAV song attachment with artwork and required release metadata
authorizedRoute.contactPublication: The official Music Submissions page publishes office@wilddogsradio.com in plaintext and directly instructs artists to use it for single-song submissions.
authorizedRoute.explicitPurpose: Free single-song submission for possible Wild Dogs Radio airplay.
authorizedRoute.permittedAutomatedScope: discovery, passive verification, enrichment, deduplication and queueing only
authorizedRoute.safeHumanAction: Reopen the official page, select one suitable MarcsMusic track, verify its ISRC and metadata, attach one compliant MP3 or WAV file plus song art, and send manually only after checking current attachment limits and AI-origin policy.

businessContact.emailStatus: one source-verified public business mailbox stored
businessContact.verification: The mailbox is published in plaintext on the official Music Submissions page and repeated on the official privacy-policy contact section. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed, and no message was sent.

formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: The canonical route is a public business email requiring audio, artwork and release metadata. A human must inspect the selected assets, confirm unpublished attachment and AI-origin rules and manually send one submission.

activityVerification.evidence: Wild Dogs Radio's first-party site displayed 2026 copyright notices, a live-listening interface, recently aired music, current and upcoming show modules, music-news items and a populated seven-day programme schedule.

genreFitEvidence: The official submission page states that all genres are accepted.
The homepage says the station supports artists from all corners of the world and broadcasts music without radio-edit censorship.
The current schedule includes Best of World Indie, alternative, metal, punk, funk, underground, record-label and live-request programming.
Selected MarcsMusic electronic, bass, hip-hop, reggae, world-fusion or experimental material has plausible fit after exact track selection.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: Wild Dogs Radio provides a legitimate free global single-song submission route and a source-verified business mailbox, but submission requires sending copyrighted audio and artwork attachments plus an exact ISRC. Attachment limits, technical file specifications, release-recency rules and AI-origin policy are unpublished. A human must inspect and select one track and send it manually.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: Repository code search was performed before creation for Wild Dogs Radio, wilddogsradio.com and office@wilddogsradio.com; no existing music-submission-agent platform, seed or queue record was found.
deduplication.consolidation: The public email route and the separate Facebook request interaction are not counted separately. Only the canonical free email-submission route is stored. Donation, merchandise, promotion, advertising and third-party-directory routes are excluded.

notes: One new free global Wild Dogs Radio opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. The official route accepts one MP3 or WAV song with artwork and required release metadata through a verified public business mailbox. No submission was made.
